latin: Theologice loquendo dico quod in aeuo non est successio formaliter intrinseca continuatiua, sed bene terminatiua; secundum philosophos tamen aliter dicerem.
translation: Speaking as a theologian, I hold that in aeviternity there is no formally intrinsic, continuative succession, only a terminative one; speaking as a philosopher, however, I would say otherwise.
